column1: # Size budget baseline (tools/lint/size_budget.py): bytes of each section group of
# the kernel ELF per build label, and why the label last moved. The gate fails
# when a group drifts from its line by more than the tolerance (0.25%, at least
# 512 B): a commit that grows the image updates this file with a reason,
# make size-update REASON=".." (one that shrinks it, to lock the gain in).

column3: C1: task stacks leave .bss for the stack window, the TCP table and boot sector cache leave .data for typed caches; kstack, caches and MemObj host code added
